# pnpm-store

pnpm's content-addressed package store. Pruning removes only packages no project uses.

**Name:** pnpm store · **Category:** Package caches · **Status:** stable · **Systems:** macOS, Linux, Windows

Upstream docs: <https://pnpm.io/cli/store>

**Detected when** one of `pnpm` is on PATH or one of `{store}` exists.

## Paths

Resolved in this order: the tool's own command, then the environment variable, then the system default.

- `{store}`: `pnpm store path` → `$PNPM_HOME` → macOS `~/Library/pnpm/store` → Linux `$XDG_DATA_HOME/pnpm/store` → Windows `%LOCALAPPDATA%/pnpm/store` (command and env results get `/store` appended)

## Locations

| Path | Item | Safety | Why | Actions |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `{store}` | pnpm store | Safe | This is a download cache; it is fetched again when needed (`REDOWNLOADABLE`) | `native:pnpm-store-prune` |

## Native commands

- `native:pnpm-store-prune` runs `pnpm store prune` (timeout 900 s, freed space measured before and after)
